bank.title: Session 1 — Data Modeling Question Bank
bank.notes: Seed bank converted from the first validated Session 1 practice exam. Future V2 generation should expand Medium/Hard and external-similar coverage.

questions.question: What is a database?

options.text: A temporary list of unstructured notes
An organized collection of data stored and accessed electronically
A programming language used only for web pages
A backup file that cannot be modified

explanation.ar: وفقًا للمادة، الـ Database هي مجموعة منظمة من البيانات يتم تخزينها والوصول إليها إلكترونيًا، وتدعم تخزين البيانات والتعامل معها.

questions.question: Which statement best describes the role of a DBMS?

options.text: It provides efficient, reliable, convenient, and safe multi-user access to persistent data
It replaces all database tables with files
It prevents multiple users from accessing data

explanation.ar: المادة توضح أن الـ DBMS يوفّر تخزينًا ووصولًا متعدد المستخدمين بكفاءة وموثوقية وأمان للبيانات الدائمة.

questions.question: Which of the following is listed as an advantage of using databases?

explanation.ar: من مزايا قواعد البيانات المذكورة في المادة: تحسين أمن البيانات وتقليل التكرار والأخطاء والتكاليف.

questions.question: Which of the following is listed as a disadvantage of databases?

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر Complexity وCost وSecurity وCompatibility ضمن عيوب قواعد البيانات.

questions.question: Which of the following appears in the course as an example of a DBMS/database system?

explanation.ar: المادة تعرض أمثلة مثل Oracle Database وSybase وMySQL وIBM DB2.

questions.question: What does a data model define in a database system?

options.text: Only the physical color of tables
The structure, relationships, and constraints of data

explanation.ar: الـ Data Model يصف وينظم البيانات ويحدد structure وrelationships وconstraints ويوفر طريقة للوصول إلى البيانات والتعامل معها.

questions.question: Which set contains the main components of a data model as presented in the course?

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر أن المكونات الرئيسية للـ Data Model هي entities وattributes وrelationships وconstraints.

questions.question: In which data model is data organized in a tree-like structure with a single parent and potentially multiple children?

explanation.ar: الـ Hierarchical Model ينظم البيانات في شكل شجري؛ كل record له parent واحد ويمكن أن يكون له عدة children.

questions.question: Which data model is described as representing many-to-many relationships among database constraints?

explanation.ar: المادة تصف الـ Network Model بأنه يُستخدم لتمثيل many-to-many relationships.

questions.question: In the Object-Oriented Model, data is represented as:

explanation.ar: المادة تشرح أن البيانات في Object-Oriented Model تُمثل كـ objects لها attributes وmethods تعمل على البيانات.

questions.question: Which data model stores data in flexible semi-structured documents such as JSON or XML?

explanation.ar: الـ Document Model يخزن البيانات في مستندات flexible وsemi-structured مثل JSON وXML بدل الجداول الصارمة.

questions.question: In the Relational Model, data is mainly organized into:

explanation.ar: الـ Relational Model ينظم البيانات في جداول ثنائية الأبعاد مترابطة تسمى relations، وتتكون من rows وcolumns.

questions.question: Which statement about the Relational Model is presented in the course?

options.text: It does not allow data independence

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر أن الـ Relational Model من أكثر النماذج استخدامًا، يسمح بالـ data independence، وتُخزن البيانات فيه في tables.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of an ER diagram in database design?

options.text: To visually represent entities, attributes, and relationships

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر أن ER Model يمثل entities وrelationships بصورة diagrammatic، ويستخدم كأداة لتصميم قواعد البيانات العلائقية.

questions.question: Which ERD symbol is associated with an entity in the course?

explanation.ar: في ERD حسب المادة: Entity = rectangle، Attribute = ellipse، Relationship = diamond.

questions.question: Which ERD symbol is associated with a relationship?

explanation.ar: المادة توضح أن العلاقات في ERD تُمثل بشكل diamond.

questions.question: A weak entity is:

options.text: An entity that cannot exist without a strong entity
An entity that has no attributes
An entity with only derived attributes

explanation.ar: الـ Weak Entity يعتمد في وجوده على Strong/Parent Entity ولا يمكنه الوجود بشكل مستقل.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a composite attribute?

explanation.ar: المادة تعرض Full Name = First Name + Last Name كمثال على Composite Attribute.

questions.question: Which attribute type is illustrated by Age calculated from Date of Birth?

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر Age from DOB كمثال على Derived Attribute لأنه يتم اشتقاقه من قيمة أخرى.

questions.question: Which attribute type is represented by multiple phone numbers for one entity?

explanation.ar: المادة تستخدم Phone Numbers كمثال على Multivalued Attribute لأن للكيان أكثر من قيمة لنفس الـattribute.

questions.question: If a relationship involves three entities such as Supplier, Product, and Warehouse, it is called:

explanation.ar: درجة العلاقة تعتمد على عدد الـentities المشاركة؛ ثلاثة entities تعني Ternary Relationship.

questions.question: Which example represents a unary (recursive) relationship?

explanation.ar: المادة تعطي Employee manages Employee كمثال على Unary/Recursive Relationship لأن نفس الـentity يشارك في العلاقة.

questions.question: What does cardinality ratio describe?

options.text: The number of attributes in one entity
The number of instances of one entity related to another
The number of columns in a table only

explanation.ar: Cardinality Ratio يحدد عدد instances من entity المرتبطة بentity أخرى مثل 1:1 و1:N وM:N.

questions.question: In a 1:N relationship, which statement is correct according to the course quiz?

options.text: One student can enroll in one course only
One course can have many students
Many students can have one teacher

explanation.ar: الـquiz في المادة يحدد Both (b) and (c) كإجابة صحيحة لأن كلا المثالين يمكن أن يمثل 1:N بحسب جهة القراءة.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an M:N relationship?

explanation.ar: المادة تحدد Student ↔ Courses كمثال على Many-to-Many Relationship.

questions.question: If every employee must work in a department, the participation of Employee is:

explanation.ar: Total Participation تعني أن كل instance من الـentity يجب أن يشارك في العلاقة، مثل كل Employee يجب أن يعمل في Department.

questions.question: How is total participation represented in an ERD according to the course?

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر أن Double line = Total Participation، بينما Single line = Partial Participation.

questions.question: When mapping an ER diagram to relational tables, entities become:

explanation.ar: المادة تنص على أن Entities become tables وAttributes تتحول إلى columns.

questions.question: When mapping a strong entity, what should be done with a composite attribute such as Address?

options.text: Store it only as an image

explanation.ar: المادة تطلب تفكيك Composite Attributes إلى atomic attributes، مثل Address إلى HouseNo وStreet وTown.

questions.question: How should a multivalued attribute be mapped for a strong entity?

options.text: Keep all values in one atomic column
Create a separate relation containing the strong entity primary key and the multivalued attribute
Convert it to a weak entity automatically

explanation.ar: المادة تشرح إنشاء relation منفصلة للـmultivalued attribute، تحتوي PK للـstrong entity والـattribute نفسه، مثل Sur_Skills(EmpNo, Skill).

questions.question: For a weak entity, which key from the parent should be included in the weak entity relation?

explanation.ar: في مثال Dependent، يتم تضمين EmpNo وهو Primary Key للـparent Employee داخل relation الخاصة بالـweak entity.

questions.question: How is an M:N binary relationship typically mapped?

options.text: By embedding all keys in one text column
By creating a new relation containing the primary keys of both entities
By deleting one of the entities

explanation.ar: في M:N لا يمكن وضع مفتاح أحد الطرفين مباشرة في الآخر؛ الحل في المادة هو relation جديدة تحتوي PK من كلا الطرفين، مثل ThCourses(EmpNo, CrId).

questions.question: In a 1:N relationship, where should the foreign key be placed?

options.text: On the N side, using the primary key of the 1 side

explanation.ar: المادة توضح أن Primary Key من جهة الـ1 يوضع كـForeign Key في جهة الـN.

questions.question: For a 1:1 relationship with total participation on both sides, which implementation is allowed by the course?

options.text: Merge both entities into one relation
Always create an M:N bridge table

explanation.ar: في حالة 1:1 مع Total Participation على الجانبين، المادة تسمح بدمج الكيانين في relation واحدة أو وضع PK لأحدهما كـFK في الآخر.

questions.question: In the unary 1:1 example Person marries Person, what is PartnerNID?

options.text: A foreign key referencing another Person NID

explanation.ar: المادة تشرح أن PartnerNID هو Foreign Key يشير إلى NID للشريك داخل نفس entity Person.

questions.question: In the unary 1:N employee supervision example, SuperEid stores:

explanation.ar: في المثال Employee(Eid, EName, Gender, SuperEid)، فإن SuperEid هو Eid الخاص بالـsupervisor وهو أيضًا Employee.

questions.question: In the unary M:N medicine example, which relation is created to record medicine combinations?

explanation.ar: المادة تستخدم Ingredients(MainDrug, CompDrug) لتمثيل علاقة M:N الذاتية بين الأدوية، ويمكن إضافة Dose إذا لزم.

questions.question: For the complex surgery relationship, why is a separate OperationData relation created?

options.text: To store the surgery date together with surgeon, patient, and surgery identifiers
To convert the database into a document model
To avoid storing any relationship attributes

explanation.ar: المادة تحتاج تسجيل SurDate مع surgeon وpatient وsurgery، لذلك تنشئ OperationData(EmpId, PtId, SurCode, SurDate).

questions.question: Which order best matches the data modeling process shown in the course?

explanation.ar: الرسم في المادة يعرض الانتقال من Conceptual Data Model إلى Logical Data Model ثم Physical Data Model.

questions.question: What is a database schema compared with a database instance?

options.text: The schema is the blueprint, while the instance is a snapshot of data at a moment in time
The schema contains only current data values
The instance never changes over time
There is no difference between them

explanation.ar: المادة تصف Schema بأنه blueprint يحدد البنية والعلاقات والقيود، بينما Database Instance هو snapshot للبيانات في لحظة معينة ويتغير مع الوقت.

questions.question: What is normalization?

options.text: A process that organizes tables and attributes to reduce redundancy and dependency
A process that adds repeated data intentionally
A method for drawing only ER diagrams
A way to disable primary keys

explanation.ar: Normalization في المادة هو عملية في تصميم قواعد البيانات لتنظيم الجداول والـattributes بهدف تقليل redundancy وdependency.

questions.question: What does functional dependency mean?

options.text: One attribute or group of attributes determines the value of another attribute
Every attribute must have random values
A foreign key determines the database server
A table must have exactly two columns

explanation.ar: Functional Dependency تعني أن قيمة attribute أو مجموعة attributes تحدد قيمة attribute أخرى.

questions.question: A non-key attribute that depends on only part of a composite primary key demonstrates:

explanation.ar: Partial Functional Dependency تحدث عندما تعتمد قيمة attribute على جزء فقط من Composite Primary Key.

questions.question: A transitive functional dependency occurs when:

options.text: A non-key attribute is determined by another non-key attribute that is itself determined by the primary key
Every attribute depends directly on the full composite key
There are no keys in the table
A table has only one row

explanation.ar: المادة تعرف Transitive Functional Dependency بأن attribute يعتمد على non-key attribute آخر، وهذا الـnon-key يعتمد بدوره على الـPrimary Key.

questions.question: What is the key requirement for a relation to be in 2NF?

options.text: It is in 1NF and every non-key attribute is fully functionally dependent on the primary key

explanation.ar: 2NF تتطلب أن يكون الجدول أولًا في 1NF، وأن يعتمد كل non-key attribute اعتمادًا وظيفيًا كاملًا على الـPrimary Key، أي إزالة partial dependencies.

questions.question: Which dependency should be removed to reach 3NF according to the course?

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر أن 3NF = 2NF plus no transitive dependencies.

questions.question: Which statement best describes a Star Schema?

options.text: One fact table connected to multiple denormalized dimension tables
Only normalized dimension tables with many sub-dimensions
A schema with no fact table
A schema used only for XML documents

explanation.ar: Star Schema في المادة له fact table واحدة متصلة بعدة dimension tables، والـdimensions تكون denormalized لسرعة الاستعلامات.

questions.question: Which statement best describes a Snowflake Schema?

options.text: Dimensions are normalized and may have sub-dimensions
All dimensions are denormalized and flat
It always uses fewer joins than a Star Schema

explanation.ar: Snowflake Schema يستخدم normalized dimensions وقد تحتوي الـdimensions على sub-dimensions، وهو أكثر تعقيدًا وأقل redundancy.

questions.question: Compared with a Snowflake Schema, a Star Schema generally has:

options.text: More complex maintenance and less redundancy

explanation.ar: جدول المقارنة في المادة يذكر أن Star Schema أبسط، joins أسرع، لكنه أكثر redundancy من Snowflake.

questions.question: Which schema is presented as better suited for complex analytics and large datasets?

explanation.ar: المادة تصف Snowflake Schema بأنه أفضل للـcomplex analytics وlarge datasets، مع normalized dimensions وكفاءة أعلى في التخزين.
